subject: expression: Fix optimizer panic in evaluate expr with null (#57403)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent (ecca340037bc). The change makes `expression.EvaluateExprWithNull` and `AggFuncDesc.EvalNullValueInOuterJoin` return errors and switches from `NewFunctionInternal` (logs + may return nil expr) to `NewFunction` (returns error), preventing optimizer panics when inner expression construction fails; planner callers handle errors conservatively by disabling the related transformations (null-reject check / agg pull-up / agg pushdown). Follow-up history on `upstream/master` shows later refactors but no indication this fix introduced a remaining correctness issue.
